This script looks at the nursery data, makes Kaplan-Meier survivorship curve and runs statistics and post hoc tests

csvs needed:nurserydata.csv

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(readr)
library(lubridate)
library(survival)
library(ggsurvfit)
library(survminer)

nurserydata <- read_csv("nurserydata.csv")

```

```{r}

#in order to run Kaplan Meier we need to setup the data,

#we need censoring status as 0 still alive and 1 died

#and we need time to event, number of days until D, or last followup, in our case session 32 in order to calculate time until death

#want to look at dates for each monitoring session,make date processed a date
nurserydata$`Date Processed`<-mdy(nurserydata$`Date Processed`)

#now I'm picking one date for each monitoring session, because sessions run across multiple days, going with the earliest date that trees were monitored
session_dates <- nurserydata %>%
  group_by(`Monitoring Session`) %>%
  summarise(
    first_date = min(`Date Processed`, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()
```

then setting up data for KM

```{r}

#here making status column, 0,1 and noting first dead sesson 
status<-nurserydata%>%
  arrange(`Propagule ID`, `Monitoring Session`) %>%
  group_by(`Propagule ID`) %>%
  summarise(
    first_dead_session = ifelse(
      any(`Dead/Alive` == "D"), #if there are any D
      min(`Monitoring Session`[`Dead/Alive` == "D"]), #then select the lowest dead 
      32  #otherwise fill fist_dead_session column with 32 (survived all sessions)
    ), status = ifelse(  #make status
      any(`Dead/Alive` == "D"), #then if there are any D in D/A
      1,  #mark D as 1
      0) , #if no D, A = 0
    Treatment = first(Treatment_fixed))%>%  #treatment from fixed treatment column
  ungroup()%>%
  filter(!is.na(`Propagule ID`))#removing NAs in propagule ID
  
#now renaming so i can join the dates with the status frame
status<-status%>%
  rename(`Monitoring Session`=first_dead_session)

#merging 
status<-merge(session_dates, status, by="Monitoring Session")

#get time until death/end. using september 16th as the planting day
status<-status%>%
  mutate(time=first_date-as.Date("2021-09-16"))

#make Kaplan-Meier Curve from the survival object
  #survival object is using our data 
curve <- survfit(Surv(time, status) ~ Treatment, data = status)

#rough plot
plot(curve)

#pretty plot!
plotobj<-ggsurvplot(curve, data=status,
  palette = c("#7B19C1","#FD6A02","#009E73"), conf.int = TRUE, 
  risk.table = TRUE,
  risk.table.height=0.25)

plotobj


#testing for statistical difference between groups 
logRank<-survdiff(Surv(time = time, event = status) ~ Treatment, data = status)

logRank
#fixed numbers for the resprouts

#survdiff(formula = Surv(time = time, event = status) ~ Treatment,

# Chisq= 9.4  on 2 degrees of freedom, p= 0.009
```

post hoc test which groups are different from each other?
```{r}

post_hoc <- pairwise_survdiff(Surv(time = time, event = status) ~ Treatment, 
                              data = status, 
                              p.adjust.method = "holm") # Options: "holm", "bonferroni", "BH", etc.


print(post_hoc)


#	Pairwise comparisons using Log-Rank test 

#data:  status and Treatment 

#   BB     CC    
#CC 0.0314 -     
#TP 0.4867 0.0092

#P value adjustment method: holm




#Pairwise comparisons using Log-Rank test

#CC 0.0525 -
```

```{r}
  filter(is.na(Resprout))#%>%

plot$`Total leaf node count`

  plot1<-plot%>%
    ggplot(aes(x=`Monitoring Session`, y=`Total leaf node count`, color=`Propagule ID`))+
```

```{r}
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)

nurserylenght<-lmer(`Epicotyl length (cm)`~Treatment_fixed +`Monitoring Session`+ (1|`Propagule ID`), data=nurserydata)

nurserylenght

summary(nurserylenght)4


nurserylenght2 <- lmer(
  `Epicotyl length (cm)` ~ Treatment_fixed +
    `Monitoring Session` +
    (1 + `Monitoring Session` | `Propagule ID`),
  data = nurserydata
)

summary(nurserylenght2)


nurserylenght3 <- lmer(`Epicotyl length (cm)` ~ Treatment_fixed * `Monitoring Session` +
  (1 + `Monitoring Session` | `Propagule ID`),
  data = nurserydata
)


summary(nurserylenght3)
```
